projects.name: Tenke Fungurume (TFM)

investment.buyout_details: CMOC bought 56% (via TFHL) from Freeport-McMoRan for $2.65bn cash (Nov 2016, deal announced May 2016); Lundin/BHR Partners sold their 24% for $1.14bn; by 2019 CMOC had consolidated 80%

projects.disputes: 2022: DRC blocked exports for nearly a year over a royalty dispute; April 2023 - CMOC paid Gecamines $800m in compensation plus $2bn in dividends over 10 years

projects.2028_plan: CMOC targets a combined 1 million tonnes of copper/year across its DRC assets by 2028
